name: @refract-org/cli

tools.name: analyze
tools.description: Analyze a MediaWiki page's full edit history. Returns a structured event stream: claims, citations, sections, templates, categories, wikilinks, and reverts — all provenance-tagged with revision IDs and timestamps.

depth.description: Analysis depth: brief (event metadata only), detailed (text included), forensic (full wikitext)

api.description: MediaWiki API base URL. Defaults to English Wikipedia.

tools.name: claim
tools.description: Track a specific sentence's provenance across revisions. Shows when a sentence first appeared, was removed, or was reintroduced — with section context and revision IDs.

text.description: Sentence text to track (partial match supported)

tools.name: export
tools.description: Export page analysis as structured JSON. Returns all events with revision, section, and timestamp provenance.

tools.name: cron
tools.description: One-shot re-observation for cron: reads a pages file, runs analysis, reports new events.

pagesFile.description: Path to file with page titles (one per line)

tools.name: classify
tools.description: Ask a model to classify a single observation boundary — revert detection, sentence similarity, edit type, template signal, or activity spike. Uses MCP sampling if no API key is configured, otherwise calls the configured provider.

input.description: Input data for the boundary (field names vary by boundary type)

apiKey.description: API key for the inference provider (optional; falls back to MCP sampling)

tools.name: get_statement_history
tools.description: Track the history of a specific statement across revisions. Returns when the statement (or a semantic neighbor) appeared, disappeared, or changed, with revision IDs, timestamps, an overall status, and a short change summary.

page.description: MediaWiki page title to ground against

context.description: Optional use-context slug for scoped analysis

depth.description: History depth: brief, detailed, or forensic

api.description: MediaWiki API base URL. Defaults to English Wikipedia.

tools.name: snapshot
tools.description: Return the revision of a MediaWiki page that was live at a date: the newest revision at or before it, with its revision ID, timestamp, section headings, and text.

at.description: Target date or timestamp, ISO 8601 (e.g. '2024-01-15'). Defaults to the current time.

api.description: MediaWiki API base URL. Defaults to English Wikipedia.

revisionLimit.description: Max revisions to fetch at or before the date (default 500)

content.description: Page text to include: plain (markup stripped, default), wikitext, or none

tools.name: review
tools.description: Observe changes to a list of pages since their last acknowledged review and return the saved review report as JSON. Saves revisions and the report under stateDir. Never acknowledges: a person inspects the report and acknowledges it with the CLI command the result gives, and an incomplete report cannot be acknowledged.

stateDir.description: Absolute path of the review state directory. All state and saved reports are written here; use the same directory the person acknowledges with.

api.description: MediaWiki API base URL. Defaults to English Wikipedia.

from.description: Initial comparison baseline revision ID for a page with no acknowledged review

limit.description: New revisions per page per call (default 200); call again to resume

sample.description: Review the bundled fictional history offline instead of pages

eventTypes.description: Show only these event types in view; the saved report stays unfiltered

section.description: Show only events in this section in view

text.description: Show only events whose text contains this in view
